sense: something seen in a dream or a trance

terms.comment: Anything seen, and so a sight in sleep. In Cicero’s philosophy it also renders Greek φαντασία, an impression on the senses (Lewis & Short).

terms.gloss: an appearance in sleep, an apparition
terms.register: vōx plērumque poētica: Lucr., Ov.; also Liv.
evidence: Liv. 8.6: in quiēte utrīque cōnsulī eadem dīcitur vīsa speciēs virī (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: First a sight, an outward look or appearance, then a figure seen in sleep; its everyday senses are look, appearance, beauty, pretext, and kind (Lewis & Short).
In Cicero chiefly an idea or image in the mind; a vision or apparition in the Fathers and Gregory, and the word of church Latin for the visions of the prophets and saints.
Its first sense is sight (see vision, sight).

phrases.latin: in quiēte utrīque cōnsulī eadem dīcitur vīsa speciēs virī
phrases.english: in their sleep, they say, the same figure of a man appeared to both consuls
